msgid: Make Masks uses the same keys in its True 3D view. When a click lands on more than one sheet or anchor, in the 3D Edit mode and in 2D, the elements under it are highlighted and listed at the top left of the graph under **Elements under the click**, in layer order with sheets before anchors; the top layer is blue and the others white. The click still grabs the first element. Click a row or press the Up and Down arrows to choose which element the next click on that overlap selects and moves. **Escape**, a click on empty space, leaving Edit, switching between 2D and 3D, or replacing the gate set closes the list.
review: Actual list sorts layer/sheet/anchor and colors top-layer rows blue/others white. Initial grab chooses nearest anchor if hit, otherwise nearest sheet; first displayed row is not guaranteed. Subsequent selection and dismissal paths match.
final_msgid: Make Masks uses the same keys in its True 3D view. When a click lands on more than one sheet or anchor, in the 3D Edit mode and in 2D, the elements under it are highlighted and listed at the top left of the graph under **Elements under the click**, in layer order with sheets before anchors; the top layer is blue and the others white. The initial click grabs the nearest anchor under the pointer, if any; otherwise it grabs the nearest sheet. Click a row or press the Up and Down arrows to choose which element the next click on that overlap selects and moves. **Escape**, a click on empty space, leaving Edit, switching between 2D and 3D, or replacing the gate set closes the list.
resolved_finding: Initial grab states nearest anchor when present, otherwise nearest sheet; later chosen overlap remains handled normally.

msgid: ``dependent_variable``, the response, is a drop-down of the numeric columns of the selected score file or files, with ``pred`` first when present. Identifier columns such as ``plateID``, ``rowID``, ``columnID``, ``fieldID``, ``objectID`` and ``count`` are not offered. The list is read from each file's header and its first 200 rows when the files change. A saved value that is not in the file is kept and flagged. ``pred`` is the probability a classifier writes: Classify saves it as ``<date>_<dataset>_<model>_result.csv`` next to the tar, and ML scoring saves it as ``results/<model>/<features>/results.csv``. When a score file has no ``pred`` column, a note under the field says so, names those two outputs and lists the columns that can be used; spaCR does not pick a response for you. A run whose response is not a numeric column of the score file stops with the same list.
review: Numeric CSV choices sample200 rows, exclude identifier set, preferpred, retain savedtext, refresh oninputchanges. No-pred note requires currentresponsepred; missing-column run branch lists available columns but doesnot promise allnonnumeric invalidresponses produce same list. Classify/ML score output paths match.
final_msgid: ``dependent_variable``, the response, is a drop-down of the numeric columns of the selected score file or files, with ``pred`` first when present. Identifier columns such as ``plateID``, ``rowID``, ``columnID``, ``fieldID``, ``objectID`` and ``count`` are not offered. The list is read from each file's header and its first 200 rows when the files change. A saved value that is not in the file is kept and flagged. ``pred`` is the probability a classifier writes: Classify saves it as ``<date>_<dataset>_<model>_result.csv`` next to the tar, and ML scoring saves it as ``results/<model>/<features>/results.csv``. When ``pred`` is selected and a score file has no ``pred`` column, a note under the field says so, names those two outputs and lists the columns that can be used; spaCR does not pick a response for you. A missing response-column error lists available score-table columns to help you choose a valid response.
resolved_finding: Missing-pred guidance conditioned on selected pred; missing-column error described without universal nonnumeric/derived-column claim.

msgid: spaCR opens with a black container holding the spaCR logo as a photomosaic. The logo holds still while the window loads, then the mosaic blows away tile by tile and the container fades to show the window. A click or a key skips it. The sequence is off when **Preferences → Animation → Startup animation** is cleared (the mosaic then shows without the animation), while **Reduce motion** is on, and when the ``SPACR_NO_SPLASH`` environment variable is set to ``1`` (the mosaic is then not shown at all). **Help → Show startup animation** plays it again inside the open window, even when Startup animation is off; under Reduce motion the logo holds and then cross-fades away.
review: Startup switch is Preferences/Appearance/Animation, Reduce motion underAppearance/Accessibility; mosaic/env/hold/skip/replay-force/plaincrossfade semantics match loading-screen code.
